note: Private campground on ~70 wooded acres at the start of the Mohawk Trail, family-run since 1981. About 241-280 sites, ~140 of them seasonal, beside nightly RV, tent, cabin and park-model rentals. Three swimming pools and a 5-acre stocked fishing pond (Lamb City Pond). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on lambcity.com + its ResNexus engine: 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, dump/laundry/store/wifi, season May 1-Oct 15, online or phone booking, phone 978-699-9780. Added fees $55-99 (2027 engine quotes: cheapest RV type 30 Amp Water Back-In $55 midweek June, $86-99 August weekend), 2-night minimum (engine), ResNexus url. Cleared max_rig_ft 65 (Good Sam figure; no operator source). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: PRICE GATE: base over US$50 with no gateway (gateways.py: none within 40 km; nearest Boston 91 km) and the family has not stayed here. The cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome can book is the 30 Amp Water Back-In at $55/night (ResNexus, Wed Jun 9 2027; $62 Tue Sep 21 2027; $86 Fri-Sat Aug 13-14 2027). The only cheaper type is the '15 Amp Water Tent Site' ($49-50). No 2026 in-season dates remain to quote.

Two-night minimum: ResNexus extended every one-night midweek search (Jun 9 and Sep 21 2027) to two nights ('ENJOY FOR 2 NIGHTS OR MORE'). Recorded in booking.min_stay; a 2-night standing minimum is acceptable when marked.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront; not changed): the operator sells 'premium waterfront sites ... direct access to the serene waterfront from our RV back-in sites (89 & 90)' on Lamb City Pond. Imagery shows the RV loops running down to the pond's east shore ~200 m west of the pin; only those two sites are claimed.
Long-stay tests: passes test 4. About 140 of ~241-280 sites are seasonal, but ResNexus sells nightly RV sites (27 free on Wed Jun 9 2027), far more than 1 in 10.
